inputs.original_text: DHS is using an ICE arrest to attack New York City’s sanctuary policies, turning one case into a broader argument for harsher immigration enforcement. Public safety matters, but portraying immigrants as a threat can fuel discrimination and distract from the need for fair, accountable policies that protect communities without treating immigration status as a proxy for danger.
inputs.modified_text: DHS is using an ICE arrest to weaken New York City’s sanctuary policies and justify broader, harsher enforcement. That’s a familiar way institutions turn an individual case into suspicion directed at whole communities—especially immigrants already vulnerable to discrimination. Public safety should mean fair, accountable policies that protect everyone, not treating immigration status as evidence of danger or using fear to roll back protections.
